description: GST Compensation Cess — starter set covering commonly-encountered items. NOT exhaustive.
schema: Each entry: { cessId, description, hsnPattern (prefix match), cessType (ad_valorem | specific | compound | conditional), cessRate (ad-valorem percent, or null), specific {amount, currency, unit} when a determinate per-unit component exists, raw (verbatim source text), autoApplicable (computable from HSN+date alone), validFrom, validTo, note }. Full definition: spec/cess-schema.md.
source: GST (Compensation to States) Act 2017; CBIC Notification No. 1/2017-Compensation Cess (Rate) and subsequent amendments. 2025 update: under GST 2.0 the compensation cess was discontinued for all goods EXCEPT the tobacco family with effect from 2025-09-22 — verify the exact notification before production use.
notes: Compensation cess applies in addition to the normal GST rate on specified luxury / sin goods. Rates are often extraordinarily high (motor vehicles, tobacco, aerated beverages, coal) and change with GST Council decisions — verify against current CBIC notifications. cessType discriminates the shape: 'ad_valorem' carries a numeric cessRate (percent); 'specific' carries a structured `specific` {amount, currency, unit}; 'compound' combines both; 'conditional' depends on sub-classification not encoded in the HSN. `autoApplicable` is false when an entry cannot be computed from HSN + date alone (cigarettes vary by length/filter; motor vehicles by engine/length/category) — surface those to the user for manual entry. `raw` always preserves the source text verbatim so the structured fields can be audited against it. IMPORTANT: under GST 2.0 the compensation cess was discontinued with effect from 2025-09-22 for ALL goods EXCEPT the tobacco family (cigarettes, pan masala / gutkha, chewing tobacco, zarda, bidi); non-tobacco entries therefore carry validTo 2025-09-21 so invoices dated before the cutover still resolve the historical rate while later invoices resolve to no cess. Confirm the exact notification + cutover date. 2026-02-01: compensation cess on pan masala and tobacco ended (Notification 03/2025-CC(Rate)); those goods moved to 40% GST (19/2025-CT(Rate)). No compensation cess applies from that date.
